Aquaculture Development Plan (ADP) — Prince William Sound Aquaculture Corp. (PWSAC)
_provenance.notes: Alaska operates the world's largest wild salmon ranching (hatchery-release) program through a system of nonprofit Regional Aquaculture Associations (RAAs) authorized under AS 16.10.400. In 2023, Alaska hatcheries released approximately 1.8 billion juvenile salmon. Hatchery returns now contribute 15-25% of total Alaska commercial salmon harvests. Prince William Sound hatchery pinks and chum dominate returns. The Valdez Fisheries Development Association (VFDA) Gulkana operated the first RAA hatchery.
